description: tether/claude_code/__init__.py is the (currently empty) package marker for the Claude Code integration subpackage; consumers import its submodules directly (e.g. cli.py runs 'from .claude_code.install import install'), so the package exposes no package-level API. If __init__.py ever grows package-level exports or an __all__, they must track the integration's public surface, of which install() in install.py is the primary entry. NOTE: this file is empty, so the tether is a placeholder boundary marker, not a content-alignment signal.
